warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.50 + 3.50 (7.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 2.50 + 3.00 + 3.00 + 3.00 (11.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02, S-03, A-03 (floor + roof plan), A-04/A-05 (elevations) and A-06/A-07 (sections) and all agree; the TRUSS T1/T2 sub-totals on S-04 (3.50 | 3.50 and 3.00 | 3.00 | 2.50) agree too. Vector CAD PDF whose text layer is in a non-Unicode Thai font (garbled), so every value was read off the rendered page at zoom.

Section 4 rule 4 (every printed x/y tick is a line): structural/plan ticks 1'''' (2.00, S-01/A-03) and A' (2.10 beyond A, S-01/A-03); roof ticks 1'/3' (1.00 overhang, S-03/A-03), A'' (1.00 beyond A, S-02/S-03/A-03), D' (1.00 beyond D, S-02/S-03 chains 1.00 + 2.00) and E' (1.00 beyond E, S-03/A-03); every TRUSS T1 panel point (1'', 1''''', 2', 2'') and every TRUSS T2 panel point (A''', A'''', B', B'', C', C''); and the A-08 bathroom tick 1''' (1.90).

1''' (1.90, A-08 bathroom enlargement) and 1'''' (2.00, S-01 structure plan and A-03 floor plan) are 0.10 apart and describe the same bathroom/corridor wall line — the structural sheet and the floor plan agree on 2.00, the bathroom enlargement alone prints 1.90. Both kept as lines (rule 4); every member uses 1'''' (2.00); nothing structural is placed on 1'''.

TRUSS T2 (S-04) is drawn from D on the left to A on the right; its panel ticks are positioned off the upper line of each gap (A + 0.833 / 1.666, B + 1.000 / 2.000, C + 1.000 / 2.000). 0.833 x 3 = 2.499 and 1.167 x 3 = 3.501 against printed sub-totals 2.50 / 3.50 — a 0.001 rounding in the drawing, absorbed by the last segment of each group. The S-03 main-roof rafter lines fall on exactly these T2 panel points (scaled 0.84 / 1.66 / 3.50 / 4.48 / 6.47 / 7.47 off the plan).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-06/A-07; the elevations call it ระดับถนน). Floor level conflict, decided: the A-06 level marker prints ระดับพื้นห้อง +0.18 and its own z chain closes with 0.18 + 3.36 = 3.54, and all five F1 room tags on A-03 print +0.18; the room tags drawn inside รูปตัด A / รูปตัด B (ห้องนอน 2, ห้องรับแขก, ครัว) print +0.54. Three printed sources against one repeated tag block — +0.18 taken; the four +0.54 tags are kept in unassigned_dimensions. On รูปตัด A the 0.18 figure is printed below the ±0.00 line (drafting offset) — read as the ±0.00 to +0.18 segment, the only place it closes the 5.57 total.
S-02 prints หลังอะเสระดับ +2.78 for the porch อะเส on row E — a second, lower อะเส level (rows A-D are at +3.54).

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-05 plus A-03 (floor plan + roof plan), A-04/A-05 (elevations), A-06/A-07 (building sections) and the A-08 bathroom enlargement. Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: the A-08 fixture-installation-height elevation (sanitary standard), A-09 door/window sizes (kept on the schedule elements), E-01 electrical and SN-01/SN-02 sanitary sheets. S-04/S-05 print only member-internal dimensions (truss heights 2.175 and 0.500 + 1.553 = 2.05, footing plan size and depth, section sizes, slab thickness), which stay on their elements.
